mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_session WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_delete = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET scope_version = scope_version + 1, last_message_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_delete = 0
UPDATE chat_session SET active_run_id = #{runId}, input_draft = '', last_message_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND is_delete = 0
UPDATE chat_session SET active_run_id = NULL, last_message_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND active_run_id = #{runId} AND is_delete = 0
UPDATE message_citation SET is_delete = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE is_delete = 0 AND message_id IN (SELECT id FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId})
UPDATE run_event SET is_delete = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE is_delete = 0 AND run_id IN (SELECT id FROM agent_run WHERE session_id = #{sessionId})
UPDATE chat_message SET is_delete = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_delete = 0
UPDATE agent_run SET is_delete = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_delete = 0
UPDATE session_paper SET is_delete = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_delete = 0
UPDATE chat_session SET is_delete = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_delete = 0 AND active_run_id IS NULL
